claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, dexamethasone acetate is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent; glucocorticoid receptor agonism does not directly kill most cancer cell lines, and any antiproliferative/cytostatic effect would be weak and not manifest as a distinct killing pattern.
